scope: Read-only consolidated fresh-context review; no target edits, product code, builds or native/model probes. Evaluate source contracts and expectations rather than treating approval as correctness.
sourcePolicy: Read relevant sources as needed and log actual reads. The target and current local linked contracts take precedence over historical versions. All new contract/fixture details incorporated by the target are reviewable. Reviewers must not retrieve parent conversation or memory.
materializationPolicy: Native reviewers receive this catalog with local materialization paths under generated review scratch. This portable copy preserves source identities and hashes; temporary locators are not deliverables or runtime dependencies. Current immutable Git sources and canonical issue/page identities are the durable citations.
